name: atlas-server
description: Atlas — Fastify (Node 22 LTS) backend for live geospatial fleet tracking. The api-heavy spine: a server-authoritative deterministic simulation engine (in-process pure-reducer loop, ADR-002), a @fastify/websocket telemetry gateway (the JSON tagged-union frame contract, ADR-003), Drizzle + Postgres for the GeoJSON route/zone/stop definitions + a bounded telemetry/events window (ADR-005), and the shared turf geo math (ADR-004). Phase 1 lands the scaffold (config + health), the Drizzle schema + migrations, and wires the shared atlas-shared contract; the engine + gateway are Phases 3-4.
